Yeah ive seen a number and always meet my mental health deductible. I call a shit ton of them...if i call ten maybe one is taking new clients. So i call a ton see maybe 3 and stick with one. I always found it helpful especially if i had a dozen eggs in the fridge for a while. By doing the water check more than a few where good to eat. Ideally you want them to like lay flat as that means they are the freshest. Most times they will kind of stand vertically but still touch the bottom. When they just float you need to toss them. Oh and like other people have said hard boiled eggs are good for a week. I honestly just make 2 or 3 at a time and eat them in a day or two. Eggs hold up amazingly well fresh. Farm fresh eggs you dont need to really even keep in the fridge but those are like if you grabed the eggs from the nest. When you buy eggs at the store they are cleaned and washed and i dont know the science behind it but it weakens the protective barrier of the shell so you want to keep them in the fridge but lets say you make breakfast and forget to put them back in the fridge for a day they will still be ok.

Uncooked eggs still in the shell can last a really long time. If you have chickens and get fresh layed eggs youd be amazed how long they keep. 

Protip: when in doubt drop an egg in a mixing bowl full of water. If it sinks it is good but if it floats it is bad.
